checkpoints.summary: Two fixed parts share named shell and lid dimensions.
Compilable enclosure missing its selectable joint geometry.
Fixed body and lid select snap hooks or external-bolt bosses and optional recesses.
A threaded fastener mates with a tapped enclosure boss.
Ellipse and polygon vents plus straight and curved adjustment slots are cut from the lid.
A service lid combines a rounded outline, profile vent, annular vent, and raised OPEN label.
Imports an Ecky-owned STL only as an explicit cable-gland reference.
Extrudes an original filled SVG badge as enclosure geometry.
